newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures quiet as feed demand grows.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures quiet as feed demand grows.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat stayed quiet on Tuesday with low-level activity based on position-squaring. Nearby March 1997 rose by A$1.00 to A$178.00 a tonne on Monday's settlement price close. Five lots traded.
With March in delivery, A$178.00 was a price everyone was happy to exit on, a trade source said. Monday night's unchanged Australian Wheat Board pool prices had no affect on futures.

A large number of shorts were dominating trade, the source said. Demand for feed wheat and barley was outstripping the market's ability to supply while sorghum prices were also strong, the source said.
